processing.frontPair: pan=stereo|c0=c0|c1=c1 (front ORTF L/R of the 8ch ORTF 3D master)
processing.loudnorm: two-pass linear, I=-20.94 LUFS, TP=-1.0 dBTP, LRA=11
processing.loopStartRationale: start chosen so the 6s before the wrap and the 6s after it sit at the same level at P=199s; trimming from 0 put a fade-in against a settled tail

recut.why: loopify-scenes.py never mixed the wrap crossfade tail in, so the loop wrapped into a fade-up from near silence. Re-cut from the source at the same window (found by cross-correlation against the shipped file) with the fixed tool: a real equal-power crossfade into the audio that follows the loop in the recording. DECISIONS.md, 'The wrap was a hole'.

notes: Front ORTF pair from 8ch ORTF 3D master, levelled by tools/level-ftus.py. Seamless-looped to 199s (prime loopOffset) for native Howler looping: 6s fade-wrap of the post-loop tail over the head so the loop point is gapless. Encoded as Opus (128k) — see DECISIONS.md 'Ship scene audio as Opus, not MP3'.
